k01-luna-front.observed_description: A grey tabby cat with a white chest sits on a wooden floor in front of a white sofa; a floor lamp stands to the right with a gap of floor between it and the sofa.
k01-luna-front.note: Usable: in front of the sofa reads at 180 px; the cat matches Luna.

k04-max-front.observed_description: A tan dog with a white chest sits on the grass in front of a very thick tree trunk in a sunny park.
k04-max-front.note: Usable: in front of the tree reads at 180 px; the dog matches Max.

k02-luna-behind.observed_description: The same living room with only the tips of Luna's ears and eyes showing over the middle of the sofa backrest.
k02-luna-behind.note: REJECTED: Luna is too small to see at phone size; remade in v2 with her head and paws large over the backrest.

k03-luna-between.observed_description: The same living room with two identical cats: one still in front of the sofa and one between the sofa and the lamp.
k03-luna-between.note: REJECTED: the edit kept the first cat, so there are two cats; the lamp is also outside the centered 4:5 crop, so between is dropped from 4.3.

k05-max-behind.observed_description: The same park with Max's head peeking out from the right side of the thick trunk; the grass in front is empty.
k05-max-behind.note: Usable: behind the tree reads at 180 px; his head sits near the right edge of the 4:5 crop but stays whole.
